notes.title: Early Access V 1.0.4
notes.content:
Map Fixes
Hostile compound

 Total Map Overhaul. Replaced buildings and props


Oil Refinery

 Fixed ladder bug in towers where it caused player to keep climbing into sky even after exiting ladders.


Other bug Fixes

 Fixed bug where Players with clan tags in block brackets couldn't connect to server
 Fixed bug when 2 players trade kills, then the hitmarker got stuck on screen.


Weapon Buffs/Nerfs
Red dots

 Increased emission strength of all attached sights on weapons. This excludes the Sniper and M64C scopes.


Scar

 Increased Fire Rate by 20%

notes.title: Early Access V 1.0.3
notes.content:
Map Fixes
Amsterdam

 Renamed Amsterdam to River town due to community feedback
 Fixed Spots to glitch out of the map


Lab

 Increased safe zone radius for master spawns to reduce spawn traps
 Closed some line of sights
 Added additional primary spawn zones


Weapon Balancing
Grenades Nerf and fixes

 Fixed sound glitch where it always sounds that every grenade explodes next to player
 Reduced grenade damage radius
 Reduced quantity of grenades at spawn from 4 grenades to only 2.


Mossberg 590 Shotgun Nerf

 Increased ADS spread by 10%


UI Changes

 Fixed bug where users couldn't save settings while in game.
